2959.title: Codex resume deprecation warning
2959.rootCauseOneLine: The Codex bridge omits the metadata-only resume option, so Codex hydrates old turns and emits a deprecation notice.
2959.proposedFix: Send excludeTurns: true on every Codex resume request and keep the existing warning translation.
2959.caveats: The direct check used Codex CLI 0.152.0 with an empty temporary Codex home and no account.
